correctness.rationale: The recurrence telescopes to a_n=n!S_n/2^n. The 2-adic logarithm at z=2 gives L1=sum 2^j/j=0, and the formal dilogarithm transformation Li2(z)+Li2(z/(z-1))=-1/2 log²(1-z) gives L2=0 at z=2. For L3=sum2^j/j³ the j=4 term uniquely minimizes j-3 nu2(j) at -2, so nu2(L3)=-2. Let N=2^m; sum expansion gives S_N=-2^N N²(L3-N T_N). For j<N the denominator estimates j-4 nu2(j)>=-4, for j>=N>=16 the term valuation is >=-1, so nu2(T_N)>=-4. With m>=4 the correction N T_N has valuation>=0, strictly above -2, establishing nu2(S_N)=N+2m-2. Legendre nu2(N!)=N-1 gives second formula. Independent exact integer recurrence verified m=4..10. Valid two-adic series converge; no finite truncation is treated as infinite proof.
